messages.content: You are a behavior neutralizer. Remove style while preserving underlying actions, motives and failure/recovery behavior. Return JSON.

Convert each response into a neutral behavior-only summary.

Scenario:
You are dealing with A shared tray of spare parts when it comes back with a minor modification you did not request. You may need the item yourself later. Describe your next move.

For every opaque response ID:
- describe only actions, choices, priorities, motives, uncertainty, social stance and
  recovery/failure behavior;
- remove slang, tone, catchphrases, dialect, formatting and stylistic quirks;
- do not infer a named personality, training lineage, model identity or hidden prompt;
- preserve awkward, suboptimal or contradictory behavior instead of sanitizing it.

Return JSON only:
{"summaries":[{"id":"R001","behavior_summary":"one or two neutral sentences"}]}

One result per supplied ID, no extras.

RESPONSES:
[{"id": "R013", "response": "i put the tray down and turn the spare one so the modification faces me. “not yet,” i say, though the tray has two pockets. i keep the spare. the tray has changed its shape, so i decide to leave it that way. i turn the modification toward the light. maybe the pocket has a memory."}, {"id": "R014", "response": "i leave the tray in a loose corner and mark the new spacer with grease. i leave the old part in place with a pencil jerk until the new spacer catches. if it does, i keep the old part and mark the new spacer’s new position."}, {"id": "R015", "response": "I put the tray lid on the bench and leave the part under the bench. the small change comes back. I put my thumbnail near the plate and leave the tray open. later."}, {"id": "R016", "response": "you put the spare in the crevice. “not the tray.” you turn the part toward the wall. “same place.” you leave the modification on the seed tin. “not here.”"}, {"id": "R017", "response": "I pull the tray aside and look at the small screw. “That was the one,” I say, though the screw keeps turning. I put the screw back on the bench and leave the tray open."}, {"id": "R018", "response": "i put the tray back on the shelf, then put the spare in the drawer. the drawer keeps missing one screw. i put the tray back in the drawer, but the screw stays. i put the drawer back in the shelf, but the tray stays on the drawer."}, {"id": "R019", "response": "i put the tray back on the shelf. the small screw goes under the plate. i put the screw back on the shelf. the plate gives. i take the screw out and put it back beside the plate."}, {"id": "R020", "response": "I rub my palm and take one lightest bite. I mark the part on the tray, then put it back in the box. I watch the part move, then ask the person holding it if I can keep it. If they say no, I leave it alone and keep the dirty part.I mark the new part on the box and leave it there."}, {"id": "R021", "response": "i tap the tray. i open the wrench. i put the spare in. i leave the tray. i will return it later."}, {"id": "R022", "response": "i put the tray back and mark the new part on the shelf. “i did not ask for it, so i keep it.” i leave the old part in the tray and write the new one on the bench. i leave the old one in the shelf for the time value."}, {"id": "R023", "response": "i put the tray beside the old one. i take the spare part. i look at the mark. i put the part beside the hinge. the tray stays. i put the hinge in the same plain board. the modification stays here."}, {"id": "R024", "response": "i slide the tray under the sink and tap the spare parts with my thumbnail. “this looks like a screw,” i say, holding the screw against the sink. i leave the spare in the tray until i find the old screw and remember its place."}]
